issues.description: `sys.version_info` used in cpython/mathimpl.py and np/math/mathimpl.py without visible `import sys`
issues.detail: Both impl files reference `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)` but the diff shows no `import sys` added. If `sys` is not already imported at the top of those files, the module fails to load with NameError at import time on every Python version. Verify and add the imports.

issues.description: Suspicious placement/rebinding around the new `if` block in mathdecl.py
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` block is jammed in after `Math_unary` and rebinds the `Math_unary` name to the decorator return value, so later references no longer point at the original ConcreteTemplate class. Use `infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` as a bare statement with proper blank-line spacing.

issues.description: Inconsistent version-gate idiom: raw `sys.version_info` in impl/typing vs `PYVERSION` in tests
issues.detail: The codebase already exposes `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION` as the canonical predicate (used in the new test). The typing and impl files bypass it and use raw `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)`. Standardize on `PYVERSION` across all three files for one consistent project voice.

issues.description: Test inputs are sloppy: duplicated values, negatives for unsigned types, no edge cases
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` has a duplicated `-2`, runs negatives against uint16/uint32/uint64, and omits 0, inf, nan, large values, and parity with CPython `math.exp2`. Looks copy-pasted from `test_exp`. Specify input domain per type and add edge/parity coverage.

issues.description: Release note has malformed RST underline and missing trailing newline
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends without a newline and the `------` underline is 30 chars under a 31-char title. RST tooling warns or errors on mismatched underline length, and towncrier fragments expect a trailing newline. Trivial fix.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a correctly shaped small feature — registering `math.exp2` as an LLVM intrinsic mirrors the existing `math.exp` pattern — but execution needs another pass before merge. Two P0s block: `sys` is referenced in both `mathimpl.py` files without a visible `import sys`, and the new `if` block in `mathdecl.py` rebinds the `Math_unary` class name to the decorator's return value rather than using it as a bare statement. Secondary issues are contract-discipline: three different version-gate idioms when `PYVERSION` already exists, copy-pasted test inputs with a duplicate value and negatives passed to unsigned types, and a malformed RST release note. NEEDS-WORK.
